blogs.title: From LSTM to xLSTM: The Big Leap in Recurrent Modeling
blogs.description: Demystify how exponential gating and matrix memories turn the classic LSTM into the powerful xLSTM, and why this matters for everyone building sequence models.

blogs.title: Why Transformers Aren’t the Only Boss of Language Models
blogs.description: Explore the limitations of Transformers that led researchers to revisit LSTMs, and how xLSTM competes on the same scale while keeping sequence length costs linear.

blogs.title: The Science Behind Exponential Gating: Giving LSTMs a Memory Revision Superpower
blogs.description: Walk through the math and intuition of exponential gates, normalizer states, and how they let LSTMs update past memories on the fly.

blogs.title: Matrix Memories in Neural Networks: A New Take on Long‑Term Storage
blogs.description: Explain the matrix‑based memory of mLSTM, the covariance update rule, and why it gives xLSTM a memory capacity edge over traditional scalar cells.

blogs.title: Building an xLSTM‑Based Large Language Model from Scratch
blogs.description: Step‑by‑step guide on assembling xLSTM blocks into a residual architecture, tuning hyperparameters, and training on 300B tokens—plus tips for inference speed.

blogs.title: xLSTM vs. State‑Space and Attention: Who Wins the Long‑Context Game?
blogs.description: Compare empirical results on Long Range Arena and associative recall tasks, highlighting why xLSTM shines where Transformers and SSMs stumble.

blogs.title: Scaling Laws for xLSTM: What to Expect as Model Size Grows
blogs.description: Break down the power‑law performance curves of xLSTM, showing its comparable trajectory to Transformers and the advantages in offset and extrapolation.

blogs.title: Optimizing xLSTM Inference: From CUDA Kernels to High Throughput
blogs.description: Discuss the practical challenges of implementing fast, parallel xLSTM layers, and how the authors’ CUDA optimizations deliver competitive decoding times.
